diagram_policy: Every coach card contains a source asset reference and a source-grounded diagram generation brief. Final original vector diagrams must be generated/reviewed before publication.
review_required: Age-group mapping is inferred from source activity type.
Duration and player ranges are inferred where not explicit.
Child challenges are new Spraoi content and require coaching review.
Final diagrams must be newly drawn and checked against each source diagram.
Open RLS policies in the database are not production security.
